name: Georgia Power Escape Room
summary: Team up with a partner on an immersive challenge at a Georgia Power nuclear facility. Your mission is to ensure its optimal operation through cooperation and strategic thinking. Engage with four distinct stations, each representing a crucial aspect of nuclear plant operations. Utilize your knowledge and analytical skills to unravel intricate puzzles at each station.
